title: Nik's Craftables - Spawn Eggs
description: A datapack that adds recipes for spawn eggs and monster spawners. Unlock spawn egg recipes by killing the respective mob.
body:
![purple text in the style of minecraft's logo that reads "CRAFTABLES"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eccdd03eda4eebaaf673eae9f78a289d03cc3314.png)

A datapack that adds crafting recipes for spawn eggs and spawners. Recipes for the spawn eggs are obtained by killing the designated mob.

Obtain Monster Spawner Recipe

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The spawner recipe is obtained by generating a spawner room chest. (Meaning open it for the first time)

</details>


Obtain Trial Spawner Recipe

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

The trial spawner recipe is obtained by generating an ominous key from a trial spawner. (Meaning you activate a trial spawner and get the ominous key as a reward. It doesn't work if you get the key from another player lol)

</details>

![9 crafting tables in a 3x3 pattern with items placed on top in each block of the crafting table. Floating above those items are spawn eggs for a wolf, cat, bee, sheep, pig, squid, chicken, cow, and salmon. ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/74092273ccf1b2cc92336c84247411f533b92c5b.png)
